english.title: Corruptly give / agree to give / offer any gift / consideration to an agent - Prevention of Corruption Act 1906
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) corruptly

(A)_[gave]_
(B)_[agreed to give]_
(C)_[offered]_

a gift or consideration, namely **(..SPECIFY..), to an agent, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..), as an inducement or reward for

(D)_[doing or forbearing to do an act, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ACT..),]_
(E)_[showing or forbearing to show favour or disfavour to any person]_

english.legislation: Contrary to section 1 of the Prevention of Corruption Act 1906.

english.notes:
This CJS Code and Standard Offence Wording document is now OBSOLETE. Repealed by the Bribery Act 2010.(i) This offence is historic. Please now see offences under section 1 of the Bribery Act 2010 – H100582 (bribery) and H100583 (conspiracy to bribe).
(ii) See also the presumption of corruption provided by section 2 of the Prevention of Corruption Act 1916.
(iii) Subsection 1(3) of the Prevention of Corruption At 1906 provides:
"a person serving under the Crown or under any corporation or any borough, county, or district council, or any board of guardians, is an agent within the meaning of this Act."
(iv) Subsection 1(4) of the Prevention of Corruption At 1906 provides: "for the purposes of this Act it is immaterial if:-
(a) the principal's affairs or business have no connection with with the United Kingdom and are conducted in a country or territory outside the United Kingdom ;
(b) the agent's functions have no connection with the UK and are carried out in a country or territory outside the United Kingdom."

other.penalty:
Summary: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: Seven years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecution:
None
